label: AB14C_oI64_74_c_3h2j_e-001
title: NaAlB$_{14}$ Structure
comments:
The stoichiometry of this sample is given as Na$_{0.95}$Al$_{0.94}$B$_{14}$, indicating vacancies on the sodium and aluminum sites. 
 (Okada, 2005) say that this is isomorphous to \href{current_web_home_dir/AB14C2_oI68_74_a_3i2j_h-001}{MgAlB$_{14}$}, but our published version of that structure has the Mg site split, rather than a single Na site. 
 The \href{../Tutorials/AFLOW_Prototype_Label/index.html#LabelOrder}{AFLOW prototype label protocol} swaps the a and b lattice constants, and moves the origin by 1/4 a $\hat{x}$ + 1/4 b $\hat{y}$ + 1/4 c $\hat{z}$, moving the aluminum atom from the published (4b) Wyckoff position to (4c).
